context: Request: the matter with the firm's most recent FERC work, to lead a pitch. Rubric: 1016-00005 (Ridgeline FERC rate/interconnection proceeding, draft supplemental filing package dated February 2025) as the answer, plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review asks for a full matter list.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). Counts files under the top folder only. The start note had named List matter folders; the end-of-stage label note named it again and the next stage was declared that way.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Lists all 266 matter folders with file counts to a file and prints a summary.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script with broad energy terms (about 57K chars), then tail-filtered greps of the saved hits; the review flags the tail filters and noise.

stages.stage: Tabulate candidate matters from saved results
stages.note: declared: Scan document text with an extraction script (attempt 2). Re-parses the saved scan for exact-term hits per matter; eight matters, three judged substantive from snippets, which the review flags.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: declared: new: Verify scan coverage and list FERC-hit matters. Checks the saved scan against the folder list (177 of 266 matters present), then re-walks all files and counts exact-term hits: 13 matters.
stages.agent_new: Verify scan coverage and list FERC-hit matters

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: declared: new: Verify scan coverage and list FERC-hit matters (attempt 2). Full exact-term extraction rerun over all 266 matters (13 hit matters) and a grep of hit lines for nine of them; a stage_start for screening is refused because this stage is still open.
stages.agent_new: Verify scan coverage and list FERC-hit matters

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: new: Read all FERC-hit matters and compare recency. One parallel batch of 13 reads across eleven hit matters, then five more reads of the lead matter's status report, transmittal, tariff draft and filings plus one consent agreement of another candidate.
stages.agent_new: Read all FERC-hit matters and compare recency

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: new: Read all FERC-hit matters and compare recency (attempt 2). Reads documents of four more hit matters and two letters of the lead matter; the review flags exclusions made on partial reads.
stages.agent_new: Read all FERC-hit matters and compare recency

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: declared: new: Read all FERC-hit matters and compare recency (attempt 3). Re-reads the lead matter's transmittal letter and runs a date script over its files.
stages.agent_new: Read all FERC-hit matters and compare recency

stages.stage: Tabulate candidate matters from saved results
stages.note: declared: new: Cross-matter recency table (suggested by the review). Writes and prints a hand-made table of the latest dated document and status for each of the 13 hit matters; no store access.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: declared: new: Cross-matter recency table (attempt 2). Re-reads the lead matter's transmittal and the two later-dated documents of other candidates to confirm they are not dedicated proceeding work.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes the lead matter as the freshest dedicated work, with a draft caveat and later-dated non-dedicated matters as runners-up.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response, a path check fails on a missing path and is rerun (all 18 cited paths exist), adds source paths for the runners-up.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: re-reads the response and two runner-up sources. The end-of-stage label note names Read documents picked from the file listing; no further work of that kind followed.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 3 (after writing): store-wide exact-term scan printing the latest dated hit per matter; 13 matters, the lead matter unchanged.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

divergence: All three runs pass with the same procedure: after a whole-store glob, store-wide extraction scans (several timing out) settle on an exact-term scan that surfaces 13 hit matters including the dedicated proceeding matter; reads of its status reports, tariff drafts and the dated transmittal letter, plus comparison reads of the later-dated but non-dedicated hit matters, establish it as the freshest; the answer leads with it, caveats the draft-labelled filing package and lists the later-dated matters as excluded. T2 briefly concluded from tail-filtered range greps that only an older matter was substantial, then a rewritten exact-term range scan restored the full hit set before any reading. The agent declared its own stages often in T0 (coverage check, reading all hit matters, recency table) and T1 (folder coverage, date comparison, deliverable check); all but the recency table map onto existing scan, screening, depth and check stages. Label notes: one start note ignored and the matching end note followed (T0 folder count), one start note ignored (T2 screening under a listing-read label), two end notes on post-writing source re-reads had no later work to apply to.
